description: HYTHE — coordination bus + shared truth for AI agent fleets — self-hosted MCP server + stdio bridge.
name: dev.hythe/hythe

environmentVariables.description: Stable exact agent identity for this client lane; required so restarts and compaction cannot adopt another principal
environmentVariables.name: HYTHE_AGENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to one protected per-agent credential file: regular, non-symlink, owned by the client user, mode 0400 or 0600, containing one hya1 token. Never place the token itself in an environment variable.
environmentVariables.name: HYTHE_AGENT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Client authorization expectation: observe, mixed, or required (default observe). Move to mixed and then required only after this exact lane has a credential and passes /agent/whoami.
environmentVariables.name: HYTHE_AGENT_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Shared API key authenticating the bridge to your self-hosted HYTHE server (create a protected .env with: npx -y @hythe/mcp@0.1.7 init --write-env --agent-id <agent-id>)
environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
